about: Recorded from a running server/cca-presence.py (team mode, relay and web side on): signed requests over HTTPS and raw bytes on the data port, in this order. Random values are written as their shape (<hex32>, <b64:32>, <age>, <time>); @label = the ticket or token an earlier step saved. roster = who is on the list from here on (everybody else signs with a key the server does not know).

steps.note: 257 bytes and no end of line
